name: GAMMA DIMENSION ~ALPHA & BETA FAN DISK~
source:
At that day, at that time...
There was a man who embarked on a battleship alone and fought for the weak people of the Red Zone.
At that day, at that time...
There was a pair of 612 who pledged to live together at the everlasting summer sea.

And now, Nayuta heads toward the Battleship yet again, facing her past and very being.
And now, the artificial goddess Eliza resolves herself to stand alongside War for the rest of her life.

[i]This is an adventure tale that connects the main star with the following ones.
This is a story about the new generation that continues to advance further and further.[/i]

[Translated from the [url=https://www.liar.co.jp/gamma-dimension/index.html#story]original site[/url]]
translation:
那天，那个时候……
有一个人，独自踏上战舰，为红区的弱者而战。
那天，那个时候……
有一对612，约定在永恒的夏日大海里共同生活。

现在，那由多再次前往战舰，面对她的过去和存在。
现在，人造女神伊丽莎决心在余生中与战争站在一起。

[i]这是一个将主要明星与以下明星联系起来的冒险故事。
这是一个关于新一代不断前进的故事。[/i]

[翻译自[url=https://www.liar.co.jp/gamma-dimension/index.html#story]原始网站[/url]]
